items.statement: I present content in different formats, such as text, images, audio, or video, to facilitate students’ access and understanding.
I adapt materials, examples, and explanations to avoid barriers that may hinder understanding.
I activate students’ prior knowledge before introducing new content.
I highlight the key ideas, steps, or important relationships involved in the task.
I provide different ways for students to participate and interact during the activity.
I allow students to demonstrate what they have learned in different ways suited to the task, for example, orally, in writing, visually, or digitally.
I provide support to help students plan and organize their work before beginning the task, such as guides, graphic organizers, or step-by-step sequences.
I provide structured support to help students review and adjust their progress during the task, such as monitoring guidelines, checklists, or self-assessment tools.
I incorporate meaningful opportunities for choice in different aspects of the activity to promote students’ autonomy and engagement.
I connect activities with students’ interests, goals, or motivations.
I design activities that promote collaboration and peer support throughout the learning process.
I organize the learning environment to foster students’ confidence, emotional well-being, and participation.
